verdict.rationale: Neon's GitHub repository describes it as an open-source serverless Postgres platform, and the source can be compiled and run locally, so a user can read and build the core product's source. missing for 10: the specific license name or terms in evidence, confirmation that the newer platform services (Functions, Object Storage, AI Gateway, Managed Auth) are also open source, and independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Neon is an open-source serverless Postgres database platform. It separates storage and compute
Alternatively, compile and run the project locally.
Neon can be run on a workstation for small experiments and to test code changes
